entries.summary: Mactan Shrine is a memorial park in Lapu-Lapu City on Mactan Island. Its Lapulapu and Magellan monuments relate to the Battle of Mactan, bringing different commemorative perspectives together at one heritage site.
overview: Mactan Shrine, also called Liberty Shrine, is on Mactan Island in Lapu-Lapu City. The memorial park includes a bronze monument to Lapulapu and a separate Magellan monument. Its commemorative focus concerns the 1521 Battle of Mactan, in which Lapulapu’s forces defeated the expedition led by Magellan. Look for the individual monuments rather than treating the park as one statue.
highlights: Identify the separate Lapulapu and Magellan monuments.
Learn the park’s connection with the Battle of Mactan.

entries.summary: The National Museum of Fine Arts in Manila houses paintings and sculpture by Filipino artists in a historic building beside Rizal Park. Its focus on visual art distinguishes it from the neighboring Anthropology and Natural History museums.

Operated by the National Museum of the Philippines, it presents works by prominent Filipino artists including Juan Luna, Félix Resurrección Hidalgo and Guillermo Tolentino. The museum occupies a distinct building opposite the National Museum of Anthropology. Plan this as an art-museum visit rather than assuming that a single entrance includes all of the National Museum complex.
